spans.s:
√likh (likháti; lilékha; álekhīt; likhiṣyáti;
likhitá; likhitvā́; -líkhya).
 —1.
scratch; furrow; slit; draw a line;
 —2.
write; write down; delineate. [younger
[]
form of √rikh: cf. ἐ-ρείκ-ω, ‘furrow’
(χθόνα, ‘ground’); ἐ-ρέχ-θω, ‘tear, rend’;
Lat. rīma, *ric-ma, ‘slit, crack’: for mgs,
observe that Eng. write is fr. the same
root as Ger. ritzen, ‘scratch.’]
